name: Email Verification Resend Success Resend Code
summary: After a rejected attempt, the user requests a replacement verification code; the resend is accepted and the same code-entry view returns to the ready presentation state.

preconditions.expression: email is unverified, the current challenge has one failed attempt, and resend cooldown has elapsed

serverInteraction.intent: Issue a fresh replacement verification code and make it authoritative.

postconditions.expression: email remains unconfirmed and a new authoritative verification proof exists with attempts reset

sourceReferences.note: Accepted resend is one independently runnable scenario; it does not require the runner to understand the enclosing behavior.
